nodes.label: Viewer Welcome Banner Image
nodes.rationale: Hero/welcome graphic for the viewer (guest) portal: a draped Philippine flag (white triangle with embroidered gold sun and stars, navy blue and red fields) with centered serif headline 'Mabuhay!' and subtext 'Welcome to the portal. We are delighted to have you here.' Dark, cinematic tone matches the app's navy theme and frames the site as a Philippine government/public-service document portal.

nodes.label: Mabuhay! Welcome Greeting
nodes.rationale: Filipino welcome ('Mabuhay!') plus 'Welcome to the portal' copy greets viewer/guest users entering the document-tracking portal.

nodes.label: Philippine Flag Visual Motif
nodes.rationale: Embroidered sun-and-stars flag imagery signals a Philippine public-sector identity; navy/red/gold palette aligns with the existing navy UI theme.

nodes.label: Viewer / Guest Portal
nodes.rationale: Filename 'viewer-welcome' indicates this banner is shown to the viewer role (guest document trackers) rather than staff/admin users.
